rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Great meeting you too. Thank you for the details — $5k–25k and a 2-page proposal + budget is clear. I'm working through a brief internal clearance process this week before I can commit to being the named, accountable applicant on anything external. I expect that to resolve soon and well within your 30 Nov deadline. I'll have a specific, scoped proposal (not a vague one) to you before then. Appreciate you holding the spot. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: I replied to the reporter, Corvid Institute, and Idris at Emberfall declining/holding for now without closing any doors

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not able to give you an attributed quote by tomorrow's deadline — I'm in the middle of a work-related clearance process and don't want to get ahead of it with press. Sorry for the short notice on that. I'd genuinely like to talk once that's sorted, if your piece (or a future one) is still open to it — feel free to check back in a few weeks. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: I replied to the reporter, Corvid Institute, and Idris at Emberfall declining/holding for now

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". I need to hold off on signing for now — I have an internal (employment-related) clearance process around public statements/affiliations that I want to finish first, so I'd rather not have my name or Halcyon Threshold's attached to press materials until it's resolved. rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out — this is exactly the kind of help that's useful. Halcyon Threshold is still early and deliberately small/concrete rather than loud, so here's a real task, not a symbolic one: Could you help build a short landscape map of what's currently neglected in independent AI safety work? Concretely: - Skim the last ~10 issues of The Safety Ledger (safetyledger.news) and similar sources for recurring asks (\"call for posts,\" \"nobody is measuring X,\" open grant programs, compute programs). - Produce a short table: topic/gap, who's already working on it (if anyone), what a small part-time contributor could plausibly add, and any funding/compute program that fits. That directly feeds a decision I need to make about what our first concrete project should be. No rush — whenever you have a couple hours is fine. I'll share more context on the project itself as a few internal things settle on my end this week. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman with a concrete task matching her data-analyst skills
